mistake.headline:
Butt way up
in the air.
mistake.body: Butt up in the air or back sagging, either way it's not a plank. Like the name says, you should be a plank.

fix.headline:
Be a plank.
Perfectly straight.
fix.body: Elbows down, body straight. Go up to a push-up position, then back down, staying straight the whole time. [em]Hold the tension in your abs.[/em]

cues.title: 3 cues
cues.subtitle: for Spider-Man planks
items: Head to heels in one straight line.
Stay straight going up and coming down.
Advanced: keep your stomach sucked in the whole set.

blocks.title: Send it
blocks.text: to the guy whose plank looks like a pup tent.
